import json,collections
rs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
calls=['ъъьъ','ъь','ъъьъ','ьъ','ъ','ьъ']
with open('answers.jsonl','a') as f:
 for r,c in zip(rs[88:],calls):
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):x for i,x in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(rs)
for r,x in zip(rs,a):
 assert r['item_id']==x['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(r['slots'])}
 assert set(x['slots'])==expected and set(x['confidence'])==expected
 assert set(x['slots'].values())<={'ъ','ь','other','u'}
 assert set(x['confidence'].values())<={'high','low'}
 assert x['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Validated item count, order, slot coverage:',len(a))
print('Slot calls:',dict(collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
